blocking_gate: The wiki physics page describes inner/outer lane path lengths but states no throughput rule for turns, and the prototype exposes nothing about curves. No controlled game capture has been run for this checkout: task 02 had no Factorio installation or disposable save available, so nothing was measured.
expected_behavior: A turn is expected not to reduce a saturated lane's throughput, but the inner and outer lanes traverse different path lengths, so per-lane timing differs. The magnitude, and whether any lane loses throughput, is not established here.
notes: Until this is observed, task 04 must not claim a turn is lossless nor that it is lossy; a turn's capacity stays the straight-lane capacity as a relaxation, with the relaxation recorded.
observation_method: Planned (CAPTURE.md 4.2): identical saturated feeds into a straight run and into a run containing one 90-degree turn; compare delivered items per interval on each lane separately with lane-specific colouring.

supplied_items.source: planned: infinity chest set to provide iron plates without limit

title: Behaviour of the two lanes through a turn
